title: ProjectDNAToolPackage
description: Metadata and definition for an agent-synthesized LiveTool in Project DNA

id.description: Unique identifier for the tool (e.g. ULID or uuid-v4)

name.description: Unique identifier of the tool matching the OpenCode tool invocation key

version.description: SemVer version of the synthesized tool

description.description: Semantic description presented to the LLM for tool selection

entrypoint.description: Relative path to the compiled/source TypeScript tool file (e.g. src/my_tool.ts)

testFile.description: Relative path to the associated unit test suite (e.g. tests/my_tool.test.ts)

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the tool

parameters.description: JSON Schema representation of the Zod parameter shape accepted by this tool
